{{Youmay|the local government of [[D'larah]]|the [[city council]] on [[Valo]] or the [[High City Council|City High Council]] of the [[High City of Refuge]]|linebreak=1}}
The '''City Council''' was the local government of [[D'larah]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demophon]]. It was headed by the [[City Governor]], and was comprised of a further eight individuals; two appointees from [[Shankti Drive Works]], two from [[Tumleh Navigation]], two from the city's residential sector, and two from the commercial.
